g.text: InPlan — View progress toward a specialization
Preconditions: the student is authenticated and views their own records.
The specialization is selected; passThreshold is configured.
Enrollment and Mark lifelines represent the current objects in the loop.
Traverse the student's enrollments in chronological order.
Add the credit snapshot to earnedCredits.
Later passes of the same course are not counted again.
Exclude this enrollment from completed courses.
Object creation is not a declared method call.
Completion requires enough credits AND all core courses.
100% credits alone does not imply completion.
